No. 1918/14 – WEDNESDAY, JUNE 10, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (Chapter 460) Notice under Section 7

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964 (Amendment), that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:-

Description of the Land to be acquired: Thirty eight (38) allotments of land in total extent of about 0.3310 hectare, depicted as lots 270 in 307 in the Cadastral Plan No. 521006 dated 28.10.2014, prepared by the Surveyor General and situated in the village called Watarappala in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 544 of Watarappala in the Municipal Council limit of Dehiwala Mount Lavenia in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ratmalana in Colombo district of the Western province and more fully described as follows.
